paragraphs: Optimum Communications, Inc. (together with its subsidiaries, the "Company," "Optimum Communications," "we," "us," or "our") is one of the largest broadband communications and video services providers in the United States. We deliver high-speed broadband, video, mobile, and advertising services to residential and business customers across 21 states.

In November 2025, we amended our certificate of incorporation to change our corporate name from Altice USA, Inc. ("Altice USA") to Optimum Communications, Inc. On November 19, 2025, our Class A common stock began trading on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") under the new ticker symbol "OPTU" (formerly "ATUS").

We are controlled by Patrick Drahi through Next Alt. S.à.r.l. ("Next Alt"), who also controls Altice Group Lux S.à.r.l., formerly Altice Europe N.V. ("Altice Europe") and its subsidiaries and other entities.

We are a holding company that does not conduct any business operations of our own. Altice Europe, through a subsidiary, acquired Cequel Corporation ("Cequel") on December 21, 2015 (the "Cequel Acquisition") and Cequel was contributed to Optimum Communications on June 9, 2016. Optimum Communications acquired Cablevision Systems Corporation ("Cablevision") on June 21, 2016 (the "Cablevision Acquisition").

We principally provide broadband communications and video services in the United States and market our services under the Optimum brand. We deliver broadband, video, telephony, and mobile services to approximately 4.3 million residential and business customers across our footprint. Our footprint extends across 21 states (primarily in the New York metropolitan area and various markets in the south-central United States) through a fiber-rich hybrid-fiber coaxial ("HFC") broadband network and a fiber-to-the-home ("FTTH") network with approximately 10.0 million total passings as of December 31, 2025. Additionally, we offer news programming and advertising services.

Our ongoing FTTH network build has enabled us to deliver multi-gig broadband speeds to meet the growing data needs of residential and business customers. Concurrent to our FTTH network deployment, we also continue to upgrade our existing HFC network through the deployment of digital and expansion of Data Over Cable Service Interface Specification ("DOCSIS") 3.1 technology in order to roll out enhanced broadband services to customers. Currently we make available 1 Gbps broadband services in most of our HFC footprint and up to 8 Gbps symmetrical speeds in our FTTH footprint, which provide a connectivity experience supporting the most data-intensive activities, including streaming 4K ultra-high-definition ("UHD") and high-definition ("HD") video on multiple devices, online multi-player video game streaming platforms, video chatting, streaming music, high-quality virtual-and augmented reality experiences, and downloading large files.

Our mission is to be the connectivity provider of choice in every community we serve.

We provide broadband, video, telephony, and mobile services to both residential and business customers. We also provide enterprise-grade fiber connectivity, bandwidth, and managed services to enterprise and hyperscaler customers and provide advertising time and services to advertisers. In 2025, we had approximately 3.1 million homes and businesses passed with our state-of-the-art FTTH network. In addition, we offer various news programming through traditional linear and digital platforms to consumers across our footprint.
The prices we charge for our services vary based on the number of services and associated service level or tier our customers choose, coupled with any promotions we may offer.

•We face significant risks as a result of rapid changes in technology, consumer expectations and behavior.
•Programming and retransmission costs are increasing and disputes with programmers and the inability to retain or obtain popular programming can adversely affect our relationship with customers.
•We may not be able to successfully implement our growth strategy.
•The financial markets are subject to volatility and disruptions, which may adversely affect our business.

In this Form 10-K there are statements concerning our future operating results and future financial performance. Words such as "expects", "anticipates", "believes", "estimates", "may", "will", "should", "could", "potential", "continue", "intends", "plans," and similar words and terms used in the discussion of future operating results, future financial performance, and future events identify forward-looking statements. Investors are cautioned that such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance, results or events and involve risks and uncertainties and that actual results or developments may differ materially from the forward-looking statements as a result of various factors.

We operate in a highly competitive, consumer and technology driven and rapidly changing business that is affected by government regulation and economic, strategic, technological, political and social conditions. Various factors could adversely affect our operations, business or financial results in the future and cause our actual results to differ materially from those contained in the forward-looking statements. In addition, important factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from those in our forward-looking statements include:

•competition for broadband, video, and telephony customers from existing competitors (such as broadband communications companies, DBS providers, wireless data and telephony providers and Internet-based providers) and new fiber-based competitors entering our footprint;
•changes in consumer preferences, laws and regulations or technology that may cause us to change our operational strategies;
•increased difficulty negotiating programming agreements on favorable terms, if at all, resulting in increased costs to us and the loss of popular programming;
•increasing programming costs and delivery expenses related to our products and services;
•our ability to achieve anticipated customer and revenue growth, to successfully introduce new products and services and to implement our growth strategy;
•our ability to complete our capital investment plans on time and on budget, including our plan to build a parallel FTTH network;
•our ability to develop mobile voice and data services and our ability to attract customers to these services;
•the effects of economic conditions or other factors which may negatively affect our customers' demand for our current and future products and services;
•the effects of industry conditions; •demand for digital and linear advertising products and services;
•our substantial indebtedness and debt service obligations;
•adverse changes in the credit market and availability of capital to refinance or repay future debt obligations;

paragraphs: Optimum Communications, Inc. （與其子公司合稱為 "本公司"、"Optimum Communications"、"我們"、"我們" 或 "我們的"）是美國最大的寬頻通訊及視訊服務供應商之一。我們為住宅及企業客戶提供高速寬頻、視訊、行動及廣告服務，遍及 21 個州。
2025 年 11 月，我們修改了公司章程，將公司名稱從 Altice USA, Inc. （"Altice USA"）更名為 Optimum Communications, Inc. 2025 年 11 月 19 日，我們的 A 級普通股開始在紐約證券交易所 （"NYSE"）以新的股票代碼 "OPTU" （原為 "ATUS"）交易。
我們由 Patrick Drahi 透過 Next Alt. S.à.r.l. （"Next Alt"）控制，而 Patrick Drahi 也控制 Altice Group Lux S.à.r.l.， formerly Altice Europe N.V. （"Altice Europe"）及其子公司和其他實體。

我們是一家控股公司，並未自行進行任何業務運作。Altice Europe 透過其子公司於 2015 年 12 月 21 日收購 Cequel Corporation （"Cequel"）（"Cequel 收購"），並於 2016 年 6 月 9 日將 Cequel 貢獻給 Optimum Communications。Optimum Communications 於 2016 年 6 月 21 日收購 Cablevision Systems Corporation （"Cablevision"）（"Cablevision 收購"）。

我們主要在美國提供寬頻通訊及視訊服務，並以 Optimum 品牌行銷我們的服務。我們為約 4.3 百萬住宅及企業客戶提供寬頻、視訊、電話及行動服務，遍及我們的服務範圍。我們的服務範圍遍及 21 個州（主要為紐約都會區及美國南中部各個市場），透過纖維豐富的混合光纖同軸電纜 （"HFC"）寬頻網路及纖維到家 （"FTTH"）網路，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，總共擁有約 10.0 百萬個接點。此外，我們也提供新聞節目及廣告服務。

我們持續進行的 FTTH 網路建置，使我們得以提供多吉比特寬頻速度，以滿足住宅及企業客戶日益增長的數據需求。同時於 FTTH 網路部署期間，我們也持續升級現有的 HFC 網路，透過部署數位化及擴充數據過電纜服務介面規格 （"DOCSIS"） 3.1 技術，以推出增強的寬頻服務。目前我們在大多數 HFC 服務範圍內提供 1 Gbps 的寬頻服務，在 FTTH 服務範圍內提供最高達 8 Gbps 的對稱速度，提供支持最數據密集型活動的連線體驗，包括在多個裝置上串流 4K 超高解析度 （"UHD"） 和高解析度 （"HD"） 視訊、線上多人視訊遊戲串流平台、視訊通話、串流音樂、高品質虛擬和增強現實體驗，以及下載大型檔案。
下表呈現 Optimum Communications 的某些財務資料及指標：
（a）客戶指標不包含僅使用行動服務的客戶。有關我們客戶指標的更多資訊，請參閱「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」。
（b）有關調整後營業利益（Adjusted EBITDA）的更多資訊，包括淨收入（損失）與調整後營業利益的比較說明，請參閱「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」。
我們的使命是成為我們服務社區中首選的連線服務提供者。
我們為住宅與企業客戶提供寬頻、視訊、電話及行動服務。我們也為企業與超大型資料中心客戶提供企業級光纖連線、頻寬及管理服務，並為廣告商提供廣告時段與相關服務。2025 年，我們的先進 FTTH 網路已覆蓋約 3.1 百萬戶與企業。
我們對服務的收費會根據客戶選擇的服務種類與相關服務等級或層級，以及我們可能提供的促銷活動而有所不同。

本年度報告包含符合1995年私人證券訴訟改革法案（Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995）第27A條款、1934年證券交易法第21E條款（經修正）意義的向前看資訊。在本Form 10-K中，包含有關我們未來營運結果及未來財務表現的陳述。用於討論未來營運結果、未來財務表現及未來事件的詞彙，如「預期」、「預期」、「相信」、「估計」、「可能」、「將」、「應該」、「可能」、「潛在」、「持續」、「意圖」、「計畫」等詞彙及用語，識別向前看陳述。投資人應注意，這些向前看陳述並非未來表現、結果或事件的保證，且涉及風險與不確定性，實際結果或發展可能與向前看陳述有重大差異，這是因為多種因素所致。
我們經營的業務為高度競爭、消費者及科技驅動且快速變化的產業，受政府規範及總體經濟、戰略、科技、政治及社會條件影響。多種因素可能對我們的營運、業務或財務結果產生不利影響，並導致實際結果與向前看陳述中所載內容有重大差異。此外，可能導致我們實際結果與向前看陳述中所載內容有重大差異的重要因素包括：
•在我們服務範圍內進入的新型光纖競爭者，與現有競爭者（如寬頻通訊公司、DBS供應商、無線數據及電話供應商及基於互聯網的供應商）對寬頻、影片及電話客戶的競爭；
•消費者偏好、法律及規範或科技的變化，可能導致我們改變營運策略；
•與難以在有利條款下談判節目協議，導致我們成本增加及失去受歡迎的節目；
•與我們產品及服務相關的節目成本及配送費用增加；
•我們達成預期客戶及收入成長、成功推出新產品及服務及落實成長策略的能力；
•本公司完成資本投資計畫之能力，包括本公司建置平行 FTTH 網路之計畫；
•本公司開發行動語音及數據服務之能力，以及本公司吸引客戶使用這些服務之能力；
•總體經濟條件或其他因素對本公司現有及未來產品與服務之客戶需求可能產生負面影響之影響；
•產業條件之影響；•數位及線性廣告產品與服務之需求；
•本公司重大負債及債務償還義務；
•信用市場惡化及取得資金以償還未來債務義務之可行性；

paragraphs: 本公司業務面臨許多風險，這些風險可能影響本公司業務與前景。以下摘要列舉某些風險因素，這些因素可能使本公司無法達成業務目標，或對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。這些及其他風險於後續段落有詳細說明。
•本公司營運於高度競爭的商業環境中。
•由於科技快速變遷、消費者期待與行為的改變，本公司面臨重大風險。
•程式設計與重播成本持續上升，與程式提供者之間的爭議，以及無法保留或取得受歡迎節目，可能對本公司與客戶的關係產生不利影響。
•本公司可能無法成功執行成長策略。
•財務市場面臨波動與中斷，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
